ui.description: Save your language, theme, and portfolio basics. Stock data and AI providers can be configured now or later in Settings.
ui.calloutTitle: You can enter without every provider
ui.calloutDescription: Unconfigured or unavailable capabilities are clearly marked as limited and never block the rest of the system.
ui.cardDescription: Keys are protected at rest and never returned to the UI; connection checks can happen separately later.

fields.portfolioHint: Stocks and holdings can be added later from their dedicated pages.

stock.title: Stock data provider
stock.description: Optional. Save an FTShare key now; capability routes can be bound and verified in Settings.
stock.keyHint: Leave blank to configure later; network outages never block saving.

inference.title: AI provider and models
inference.description: Optional. Chat and Embedding can use different providers and models.
inference.hint: Save the provider and models, then verify each connection separately in Settings.
inference.validation: If you enter AI settings, provide a provider, API key, Chat model, and Embedding model together.

ui.footer: You can manage providers, routes, language, and theme later in Settings.

validation.inference: Complete the AI provider, API key, and both models, or leave them all blank.

states.saveError: Initialization failed. Review the fields and try again.

initialization_validation_failed.title: The initialization configuration is invalid
initialization_validation_failed.detail: Review the language, theme, portfolio name, and provider settings, then try again.

initialization_already_completed.title: Initialization already completed
initialization_already_completed.detail: The system has already completed initialization and cannot save the first-run configuration again.

initialization_not_completed.title: Initialization is not complete
initialization_not_completed.detail: Complete initialization before using features that require a workspace.
